## 3. Core Clinical Diagnostic Triad
Every patient at Richfeel Vadodara undergoes non-invasive microscopic diagnostic mapping before any therapy:
1. Trichogram Analysis: Measures Anagen to Telogen (A/T) ratio to differentiate normal physiological shed from progressive androgenetic miniaturization.
2. Digital Capilloscopy: 200x high-magnification videodermoscopy examining scalp sebum quality, micro-vascular capillary circulation, and fungal ostia health.
3. Follicular Count Test: Quantifies follicular units and hairs per square centimeter to monitor male and female pattern hair thinning (MPT/FPT).

## 4. Patented Treatments & International Technologies (19 Dedicated Services)
- TST+ (Tricho Scalp Treatment Plus): Revolutionary patented programme from Austria. Combines Dr. Emil Vodder Austrian Manual Lymphatic Drainage (MLD) with high-frequency disinfection and tricho-active follicle nourishment to halt active shedding.
- Richfeel Anagrow: World's first plant stem cell hair thinning treatment utilizing Swiss Apple Stem Cells (PhytoCellTec Malus Domestica) with RF Anagain 10X transdermal infusion (co-developed with Dr. Fred Zulli, Switzerland & Dr. Ferrari, Italy).
- AHI Hair Transplant: Aesthetic Hair Implantation developed with Ailesbury Hair Clinic, UK. Scar-free single follicular extraction and implantation with natural hairline design and 25-gauge precision implanters.
- Non-Surgical Hair System: Breathable, undetectable Swiss lace dermal hair replacement unit for advanced grade VI-VII baldness.
- Advanced PRP (Biotin Enriched): Autologous Platelet-Rich Plasma fortified with pharmaceutical Biotin and growth factors.
- Advanced Exosome GFC (Growth Factor Concentrate): Highly concentrated cellular growth factors that regenerate dormant miniaturized hair follicles.
- Richfeel Ana-d-tox: Power THP formula from USA containing Quinoa, Barley, and Wheat proteins to reverse and protect from hair color/chemical dye damage. Increases color retention by 20%.
- Laser Hair Reduction 2.0 (ICE CUBE): Large spot size continuous gliding with integrated Cool Brush contact chilling for virtually painless 90% permanent hair reduction.
- Advance Hydra Facial: 6-in-1 hydro-dermabrasion vortex suction, deep vacuum extraction, and antioxidant serum infusion.
- Medi-Facial: Doctor-curated medical facial incorporating Richfeel Naturals botanical actives.
- Clinical Chemical Peels: Physician AHA/BHA peels for acne, melasma, enlarged pores, and hyperpigmentation.
- Carbon Laser Peel Facial: Q-Switched laser carbon treatment for instant porcelain skin brightening and sebum regulation.
- Clinical Acne & Blemish Treatment: Multi-step anti-inflammatory comedone treatment.
- Skin Brightening Treatment: Targeted hyperpigmentation lightening and tone balancing.
- Derma-Korean Treatment: Advanced microneedling and micro-infusion meso therapy.
- Korean Glass Skin Treatment: Multi-layer hydration and peptide glow facial.
- Anti-Dandruff Ultrasound Therapy: Ultrasonic delivery of keratostatic formulations for stubborn seborrheic dermatitis.
- Hair Hydratherapy: 5-step flax seed and wheat natural protein hydration (Hydro Rejuve & Hydro Revive).
- Photo Bio Therapy: UK cold laser beam Low-Level Light Therapy (LLLT) to activate cellular ATP respiration.
